protocol: specialist-compact-v3; existing prescribed S1-mini contract, CPU-only quality validation extension
reviewer: Assistant manually read all40 actual normalized inputs, restored provider candidates and final Core outputs. Identity visible; agent judgment, not human sign-off. No model/prompt/source/config tuning performed by reviewer.
scope: POST-HOLDOUT VALIDATION EXTENSION. These40 cases were already exposed for Emberon/Scribe before adding S1. This is not fresh heldout evidence for S1, and CPU execution with gpu_layers=0 proves neither GPU behavior nor whole-app SLA compliance. Text-fixture probe through the real DictationEngine, dictionary, number normalizer, optional cleanup provider and delivery orchestration. A generated tone and canned transcriber feed the selected transcript; RecordingTextInjector counts calls without typing. This does not test recognition accuracy, a microphone, a physical hotkey, foreground application insertion, Windows worker ownership or whole-desktop performance. Candidate text precedes Core validation; output is the accepted result or original-text fallback. Automatic checks do not establish semantic fidelity.

review_reuse.rule: Current40 manually read; exact normalized-input/final-output matches reuse semantic/presentation judgment. Candidate fields retain this actual execution and adapter/Core credit.

definitions.faithful: Final/provider text preserves intended facts, speech act, uncertainty, emphasis, precision and quoted wording. Known source/type or intentional emphasis loss fails even when Core accepts the output.
definitions.useful: A faithful edit addresses a needed cleanup defect; failed semantic edits and unchanged defective input get no useful credit.
definitions.fully_cleaned: Faithful directly usable text resolves needed defects; faithful preservation qualifies on no-edit inputs. Harmless punctuation and explicitly allowed connectives can differ from examples.
definitions.acceptable: Faithful, fully clean plain text. Core Applied/Unchanged does not certify meaning.
definitions.raw_model_output: Not available in this report. Provider candidates already include deterministic span restoration; bytes restored by code are not model copying quality.
